About Us
Careers
If you’re looking for a challenge, where your work saves lives, then you’re in the right place. Forwood is a truly people first, team orientated organisation, where ideas and passion are championed.
We’re always keen to receive resumes from talented, hard working professionals with a passion for risk and safety management. Upload yours now and remember to include a short paragraph about why Forwood appeals to you.
Please know that we also want to help you grow and are happy if you don’t have 100% of the skills required for a particular role. Let’s protect people and our planet, together.
We are currently seeking the following roles:
Job Opportunities
Employee Testimonials
What our employees say about us
Forwood has been my professional home since 2016, starting as a Project Manager and now Head of Client Success. Their commitment to equality, diversity, and career growth is truly inspiring. Forwood has supported me through both good and challenging times, exemplifying what it means to be an inclusive company that values and nurtures its employees.
Meagan
In my role as a Solutions Specialist at Forwood Safety over the past 18 months, I’ve collaborated with global prospects, delivering products that save lives and make a significant impact. It’s been incredibly rewarding to contribute to such a meaningful team and see real results in safety improvements worldwide. It’s also exciting to see consistent rapid product change within Forwood Safety.
Sean
I’m incredibly grateful for the opportunity to work at Forwood Safety. Everyone’s expertise has consistently elevated our projects to new heights. Moreover, I deeply appreciate the values that Forwood Safety sets and strongly stands by.
Mina
I asked to join Forwood after hearing the company’s vision and mission when I met the CEO Steve Wood. The positive impact seeing customers who are truly preventing fatalities in some of the most dangerous workplaces is a huge drawcard for me.
Clinton
I am delighted to share my experience with Forwood. Having been associated with this remarkable organisation, I can confidently say that it has set a benchmark for excellence and innovation in the industry. The leadership at Forwood deserves special mention. They lead by example, promoting a culture of integrity, innovation, and excellence. I’m incredibly grateful to be part of Forwood Family!
Akanksha
Subject Matter Expert (SME) Content Excellence – Forwood (since 2008)
Forwood is a great place to work because it embodies fostering ‘stand-out’ values such as respect, recognition, safety, and care within an inclusive, family-like team. Teamwork plays a pivotal contribution of our collective success, with every team member playing a vital role in achieving business goals. These values don’t just make Forwood a great place to work; they offer a space to grow, feel valued, supported and help make the world safer. An organisation where you can genuinely make a difference.
Donna
Working at Forwood Safety for 2 years in the HR department has been an incredible experience. The supportive team, innovative projects, and growth opportunities create an ideal environment for professional development. The company’s dedication to excellence and employee well-being makes it a joy to come to work each day. Proud to be part of this amazing team!
Sakshi
Working at Forwood has been an incredibly rewarding experience. The company truly cares about its employees and offers a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. The emphasis on work-life balance allows me to excel both professionally and personally. Additionally, Forwood is committed to continuous learning growth, providing numerous opportunities for professional development and skill enhancement. I feel fortunate to be part of a team that prioritises both the well-being and advancement of its employees. And I always feel proud and happy for working with Forwood which is working on a mission to reduce the fatality rates and save lives of people.
Vikramaditya
Being a part of Forwood Safety as a Frontend Developer has been truly rewarding. It’s not just about coding; I’ve had the chance to broaden my skills, including with cloud services like AWS. The supportive environment fosters both personal and professional growth, and receiving recognition for my contributions adds to the sense of fulfilment. Proud to be part of the Forwood family!
Sachin
As a business analyst, I have had the privilege of working with different companies, teams, and clients but my experience with Forwood stands out as particularly exceptional.
Forwood is a shining example of a business that is driven by strong and commendable values. Most importantly, it is an organisation that is passionately committed to the noble and critical goal of achieving zero fatalities. Tireless efforts in promoting safety and preventing fatalities are nothing short of inspiring.
Vikas
Working at Forwood has been an incredible experience. The company truly values its employees, offering numerous opportunities for professional growth and development. The inclusive and supportive culture fosters collaboration and innovation, making it a fantastic place to work. I am proud to be part of such a forward-thinking and employee-centric organisation.
Pramati
This is my first job experience with a fatality prevention service provider. I am proud to be part of Forwood, which prioritises safety and continuously strives to improve industry standards. I’m tremendously excited about Forwood’s growth and future prospects.
Penny
The people, culture, growth opportunities, innovative projects, exciting technology and challenging problems to solve – these are the reasons why I’ve remained a part of the Forwood Family for over six years and counting.
Adam
